Q5460.reason: An employee's statement on a matter within the scope of employment, made during the relationship, is a party-opponent admission under FRE 801(d)(2)(D) and is not hearsay.

Q8222.reason: BK polyomavirus reactivates under heavy immunosuppression and causes tubulointerstitial nephritis, with a rising creatinine that mimics rejection about 6 weeks after transplant, while the other options don't explain the kidney injury.

Q5849.reason: The defendant only said the records were kept regularly, so the court will require more foundation on authentication, business-record qualification, and the reliability of the computer process.
